selection.rule: exclude instability/T2I regression first; at stage boundaries use mean rank across text loss, image-flow loss, gradient-balance log error, and shared-backbone negative-cosine conflict; rank final/best text and image-flow losses for finalists; final generation uses Pareto/mean-rank over Caption CLIP (max), FID (min), and IS (max), with validation loss only as tie-break

generation_protocol.caption: one deterministic I2T sample for each of 1000 ImageNet classes
generation_protocol.clear_t2i_regression: exclude only when FID rises by max(1.0, 5% of baseline) and IS falls by max(baseline IS std, 1% of baseline IS)

staged_training.resume_contract: optimizer+scheduler+EMA+RNG+sampler; stop_after_steps is operational and excluded from the numerical signature
staged_training.existing_candidates_past_boundary: reuse checkpoint and metrics; never stop, modify, or duplicate-submit

lambda_text_sweep.center: median(g_image/g_text) on the fixed checkpoint probe
